description: Reads the Impressum (legal notice required on German websites, §5 TMG/DDG) at the page URL you give: e-mail addresses, phone numbers, postal address lines and the notice text as Markdown. Values are read from the page as published; no check that the operator is correct. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: Full http or https address of the Impressum page of a German website
